name: ghats_pipes
description: A Scottish Highland piper on the far ridge: a steady drone on A, the Pa of the tanpura, and a chanter that plays the same five notes as the bansuri with a snap and a neighbour gracenote; no swell, no vibrato (a pipe has no dynamics), heard across the valley.
